create_point: create a Point object from a dictionary containing point cloud coordinates and features
build_point_serialization: build serialization codes for a Point object using z-order or other space-filling curve orders
run_point_sparsify: run sparsify on a Point object to prepare a SparseConvTensor for sparse convolution
test_point_init: test Point initialization that auto-generates batch from offset or offset from batch
review_point_class: review the Point class that manages batched 3D point cloud properties and serialization
